items.text: Triangular flying object "TR-3A." Rumors say some components may come from space.

It's rumored that the triangular UFO filmed from the missile destroyer USS Russell in July 2019 wasn't a UFO at all. Some say it was actually the Astra. According to the rumor, it had been deployed to repel UAPs that had suddenly gathered over San Diego Bay.

On the topic of weapons, another curious story has been circulating. People across Japan report seeing beams of light shooting into space, even from the mainland. This has led to speculation that they might be designed to intercept UAPs. More on this in the next issue.

The Pentagon sets its sights on the extraterrestrial!
Could the new Pentagon legislation finally expose the truth about the Roswell Incident?!

According to recently obtained information, the 2024 National Defense Authorization Act and the 2024 Intelligence Authorization Act are expected to pass. Sources suggest that, as a result, Roswell-related documents should be declassified at an upcoming congressional UFO hearing. One can't help but wonder whether claims will emerge that the Astra was built using technology supposedly derived from the Roswell incident.
